summary: Second-granularity rescue dir (:897) is non-exclusive; a same-second sequential run could reuse it and clobber a prior rescue copy/manifest
evidence: scripts/sync_repo_root.py:897 (strftime %Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ, no pid/nonce, no mkdir(exist_ok=False)), :521-523 (shutil.move replaces existing dest), :534-535 (manifest overwrite). Codex epm:code-review-codex v1 Major 1; adjudicated Real-nonblocking in epm:review-reconcile v1 (plan §4.3 prescribes this exact format; flock-serialization + network round-trips make same-second reuse implausible in production; restore reads the in-memory ledger)

summary: sweep() removes/moves files before _write_ledger persists the manifest; a mid-sweep SIGKILL leaves actions with no durable manifest (bytes remain recoverable)
evidence: scripts/sync_repo_root.py:515,:523 (actions) vs :732,:758 (ledger write after sweep returns). Plan §4.3 binding text requires ledger BEFORE THE PULL only — satisfied (:732 precedes :737). Codex epm:code-review-codex v1 Major 2; adjudicated Real-nonblocking in epm:review-reconcile v1 (rescued files preserved in rescue dir with relative paths; identical-removed files re-hash-verified byte-identical to origin/main blob, rematerialized by next pull)

load_sweep_journal (:592) raises on a torn trailing journal row, skipping restore of valid rows (exit 6); tolerate+report trailing tear, loop the :571 os.write, pin with a torn-line test
evidence: scripts/sync_repo_root.py:589-598 bare json.loads per line (no JSONDecodeError handling); :1116-1126 exception routes to exit 6 and skips restore incl. the :1118 in-memory-ledger union; :571 os.write return unchecked (short write on disk-full = the live-process tear producer, Claude v2 Minor). Raised by Codex epm:code-review-codex v2 Major 1 + Claude epm:code-review v2 Minors; adjudicated Real-nonblocking in epm:review-reconcile v2 — fail-loud (traceback + rescue-dir path in report), zero byte loss (rescue dir + journal + manifest retained; removed files re-hash-verified byte-identical to recorded origin_blob_sha), and the parent concern sweep-before-durable-ledger was itself CONCERN-weight at r1. Fix: tolerate ONLY a malformed TRAILING line (record it in the report, return prior complete rows), fail loud on non-trailing corruption; loop os.write until all bytes written; test: journal with one valid row + truncated trailing row -> loader returns the valid action without raising.

summary: restore_swept (:675) reports KEPT-IN-RESCUE + a rescue-copy path that does not exist for a journaled-not-applied rescue intent (the occupant IS the original file); report 'intact - move never applied'
evidence: scripts/sync_repo_root.py:673-680 — the target.exists() branch emits 'rescue copy at {a.rescue_path}' before any rescue_copy.exists() check; for an applied=False journal row the shutil.move never ran, so no rescue copy exists and the file is intact at its original path. Codex epm:code-review-codex v2 Minor; adjudicated Real-nonblocking in epm:review-reconcile v2 — data intact, audit message factually wrong (would send an operator hunting a nonexistent rescue copy during crash recovery). Fix: check rescue_copy.exists() before emitting KEPT-IN-RESCUE; emit 'intact — move never applied' for the not-applied-with-target-present case.
